title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Further Strengthening the Work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Seriously Studying and Implementing the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Further Strengthening the Work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates"

Fa Fa [2006] No. 15

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued the "Decision on Further Strengthening the Work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates" (Zhong Fa [2006] No. 11, hereinafter referred to as the "Decision"), which is a major event in the construction of democracy and the rule of law in our country. The Decision sets forth clear and specific requirements for comprehensively strengthening the work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates under the new situation. The following notice is given to the People's Courts regarding the study and implementation of the Decision.

I. Fully Recognize the Significant Importance of the Decision

The Party Central Committee has specifically made a decision on strengthening the work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates. This is a major measure to thoroughly implement the basic strategy of governing the country according to law and to build a socialist country under the rule of law, fully demonstrating the high importance attached by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary to the work of the People's Courts and People's Procuratorates. The Decision elaborates on the importance of strengthening the work of the People's Courts from the perspectives of enhancing the Party's governance capacity, consolidating the Party's ruling status, and fulfilling the Party's ruling mission; from the perspectives of implementing the basic strategy of governing the country according to law, maintaining long-term national stability, and ensuring the people's peaceful life; and from the perspectives of promoting economic construction and social development, safeguarding social fairness and justice, and building a socialist harmonious society. This is of great significance for further unifying the whole Party's understanding of the work of the People's Courts and further optimizing the judicial environment. At the same time, the Decision sets forth new and higher requirements for the work of the People's Courts in terms of effectively performing judicial functions, adhering to justice for the people, advancing judicial system reform, and strengthening the construction of the People's Courts team. The Decision is a strategic and programmatic document for strengthening the work of the People's Courts in the current and future periods. It is a great encouragement and a powerful spur to all courts and judges across the country, and will inevitably greatly enhance the confidence of all judges and staff in performing judicial functions according to law, striving to achieve judicial fairness, and pushing the work of the People's Courts to a new level.

II. Carefully Organize Study and Deeply Grasp the Essence of the Decision

The study of the Decision should be regarded as an important political task for the People's Courts at present. Leadership and organization should be strengthened, specific arrangements should be made, and the task should be earnestly grasped and carried out well. The Party leadership group study center of courts at all levels should arrange a special study and discussion to propose measures for implementation. At the same time, the essence of the Decision should be conveyed to every judge and staff member to unify thinking, enhance confidence, and boost morale. The study of the Decision should be organically combined with the ongoing education on socialist rule of law concepts, education on socialist views on honor and disgrace, and the special rectification activity of "standardizing judicial conduct and promoting judicial fairness," so as to promote mutual progress and enhance the learning effect. The focus should be on studying the contents of the Decision regarding the statutory duties, historical mission, and functional role of the People's Courts, seriously studying the new requirements posed by the new situation for the work of the People's Courts, and in-depth discussing how the People's Courts should adhere to the work theme of "fairness and efficiency," effectively perform judicial functions, and maintain the overall situation of reform, development, and stability; how to adhere to justice for the people and protect the fundamental interests of the broadest masses of the people; how to actively and steadily advance judicial system reform under the leadership of the Party, improve the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, and ensure the realization of fairness and justice in the whole society; and how to vigorously strengthen the construction of the People's Courts team, cultivating a team of judges with firm political convictions, professional competence, good conduct, and judicial fairness.

III. Thoroughly Implement the Requirements of the Decision to Promote Comprehensive Development of the Work of the People's Courts

The Decision sets forth specific requirements for the work of the People's Courts. Implementing these requirements is the foundation for the further development of the work of the People's Courts. In the current and future periods, People's Courts at all levels should, in accordance with the requirements of the Decision, effectively perform judicial functions, punish crimes that endanger national security, public order, and the market economic order in accordance with the law, actively participate in comprehensive management of public security, regulate civil and economic relations in accordance with the law, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of all types of market entities, and strive to achieve the organic unity of legal effects and social effects; adhere to the guiding principle of "fair justice, wholeheartedly for the people," insist on justice for the people, convenience for the people, and protection of the people, improve and perfect case filing work, improve the judicial aid system, promote judicial democracy, enhance trial transparency, improve the circuit trial system, expand the scope of application of summary procedures, strengthen litigation mediation work, improve the enforcement work mechanism, and smooth the channels for appeals and retrials; in accordance with the Central Committee's requirements on judicial system and working mechanism reform, adhere to the Party's leadership over judicial reform work, base on China's national conditions, and actively and steadily advance judicial reform; vigorously strengthen the ideological and political construction of the court team, the professional construction of judges, and the construction of party conduct and clean government, enhance judges' political awareness, overall situation awareness, responsibility awareness, and self-discipline awareness, and continuously improve judges' political quality, professional quality, and professional ethics; strengthen the construction of grassroots courts, optimize the personnel structure, streamline the administrative organs, strengthen the front line, improve the working mechanism, and increase work efficiency; continuously enhance the concept of the Party, consciously accept the leadership of the Party, and ensure that the Party's line, principles, policies, and national laws are correctly implemented in trial work.

IV. Rely Closely on the Leadership of the Party Committee, Supervision by the People's Congress, and Support from the Government to Implement the Central Committee's Policies and Measures

The issuance of the Decision provides a historic opportunity for the development of the cause of the People's Courts and opens a broad path for the work of the People's Courts. Currently, the important thing is to implement the contents of the Decision. To this end, it is necessary to rely closely on the leadership of the Party committee and the support of the government, and study concrete and effective measures. The Supreme People's Court is studying and formulating specific opinions on implementing the Decision, and will hold a special meeting to make arrangements. At the same time, it will continue to communicate and coordinate with relevant central departments to strive for strong support in terms of cadre co-management, personnel staffing, and funding guarantees. Courts at all levels should actively report to local Party committees, people's congresses, and governments on key situations and issues in court work, strengthen communication with relevant departments, strive for strong support, and ensure that the policy measures proposed in the Decision are implemented. At the same time, they should work closely with procuratorial organs, coordinate actions, and jointly implement the requirements of the Central Committee.

Please promptly report to the Supreme People's Court the situation of studying and implementing the Decision in each region.

June 22, 2006
